BEFORE THE NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION

    IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF EL PASO                           )
    ELECTRIC COMPANY FOR REVISION OF ITS RETAIL                           ) Docket No. 25-00082-UT
    ELECTRIC RATES PURSUANT TO ADVICE NOTICE                              )
    NO. 317                                                               )

                                         BENCH REQUEST

        THIS MATTER comes before the New Mexico Public Regulation Commission

(“Commission”) upon El Paso Electric Company’s (“EPE”) application for revision of its retail

electric rates. Pursuant to 1.2.2.29(C) and 1.2.2.35(K) NMAC, the Commission issues this Bench

Request to obtain information concerning EPE’s cost of capital and the investor return information.

        1.      In their joint testimony on behalf of Stephen Fischmann, Mark Ellis and Joel

Hornstein address EPE’s proposed 10.70% return on equity (“ROE”) and recommend a 7.0%

ROE. Their testimony discusses information concerning returns to EPE’s indirect owners and

investors in IIF. 1

        2.      The testimony states that EPE identified certain investor-return information

available to it that it was willing to produce, including reporting for 2025. It also describes an

October 14, 2026, order denying a motion to compel information concerning owner valuations. 2

The present request focuses on investor communications and financing information, rather than

the internal valuation discount rates sought in that discovery.

        3.      Information concerning the returns presented to prospective investors may assist

the Commission in evaluating EPE’s proposed cost of capital. A fund-level target or realized

investment return, however, is not necessarily equivalent to EPE’s forward-looking cost of equity.




1
  See Testimony of Mark E. Ellis and Joel D. Hornstein on behalf of Stephen Fischman (“Joint Testimony”) at
33–40.
2
  See Joint Testimony at 36–37.
 The Commission therefore seeks the underlying materials and sufficient explanation to distinguish

the investment, financing, and return measures involved.

       4.      EPE shall respond to the following inquiries. For recurring materials, provide the

most recent version available along with any earlier version circulated since the filing of this rate

application that materially changes the return targets, assumptions, or discussion of EPE. Identify

the date and issuing entity for each document.

               a. Prospective Investor Materials: Please provide the private placement

                   memoranda (or equivalent), investor presentations, marketing materials, fund

                   fact sheets, due-diligence responses, and other written materials furnished or

                   made available to prospective investors in the IIF fund or investment vehicle

                   that directly or indirectly holds EPE, to the extent those materials describe

                   expected or targeted returns, distribution yields, return objectives, or EPE’s

                   investment characteristics. Include materials prepared or distributed by IIF,

                   JPMIM, or their representatives. Identify the relevant fund or vehicle and its

                   relationship to EPE. Complete responsive documents may be provided;

                   unrelated portions may be omitted if the omission is identified and sufficient

                   context is retained to interpret the responsive information.

               b. EPE-Specific Investor Information: Please provide portions of investor

                   materials and reports that separately identify EPE’s expected or historical

                   returns, distributions, capital contributions, financing needs, or regulatory ROE

                   assumptions. Separately provide the 2025 investor rate-of-return reporting and

                   other investor-return information described as available to EPE in the discovery

                    discussions identified at page 36 of the Joint Testimony. State whether that

                   information has already been produced and, if so, identify the production

                   precisely.

               c. Please provide EPE’s actual capital structure and embedded cost of debt as of

                   the test-period end and the most recent quarter-end available, identifying dates,

                   balances, weights, and component costs.

       IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED:

       A.      On or before December 1, 2026, EPE shall file a Response to the Commission’s

Bench Request on the record which addresses the inquiries set forth in Paragraph 4 of this Order.

The response should be accompanied by a verifying affidavit or unsworn affirmation.

       B.      This Order is effective when signed.

       C.      In computing time in accordance with statute, regulation, or Commission order, the

computation shall begin on the date that this Order is filed.

       SIGNED under the Seal of the Commission at Santa Fe, New Mexico, this 16th day of

November, 2026.

                         NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION

                         /s/ Patrick J. O’Connell, electronically signed
